recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a smiling man in a denim jacket, positioned on the right, set against a desaturated industrial landscape with a large warehouse and overcast sky. The design features layered, textured typography with a denim-like stitching effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the right facing toward the left negative space
Industrial background providing a gritty, grounded context to the clean portrait
Textured, large-scale background lettering interacting with clean foreground text
Cool blue denim tones contrasting with warm skin tones and neutral grays
coreInvariants: Overcast, diffused lighting on the subject's face
Desaturated, slightly greenish-gray color grading in the background
Denim texture motif appearing in both clothing and graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 40% of the frame, cropped from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move left to the large textured initials, then down to the smaller foreground name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is used for typographic elements against a cloudy sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm flesh tones and white (teeth and undershirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white shirt and dark jacket.

letterConstructionRules: Large background letters feature a dashed white 'stitching' border
Foreground text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with rounded corners
Background letters have a distressed, fabric-like inner texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initials are scaled to nearly half the height of the canvas
Foreground name is centered horizontally over the larger initials
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Superimposed layers where a clean, modern sans-serif sits atop a heavily textured, illustrative block letter.

preserve: The contrast between clean white text and dark textured text
The square, masculine proportions of the letters

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square, geometric feel of the foreground text.
Provides the heavy weight needed for the background textured initials.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up of a man with short brown hair and a beard, smiling, wearing a dark denim jacket over a white t-shirt. He is positioned on the right side of the frame. The background is a desaturated, overcast industrial scene with a large corrugated metal warehouse and railroad tracks at the bottom. The sky is cloudy and gray.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large blocky initials in the upper left with a dark denim texture and white dashed stitching borders. Overlap these with a smaller, clean, wide geometric sans-serif name in white with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned on the right third?
Does the background text have a visible stitching effect?
Is the color palette desaturated and moody?
Is the foreground text legible against the textured background?

mustRedesign: Exact layout of the railroad tracks
postGenerationChecks: Check that the stitching on the letters looks like thread, not just dots.
Ensure the subject's smile looks natural and not forced.
Verify the industrial background doesn't distract from the face.
Confirm the two layers of text are clearly distinguishable.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a clean masculine portrait with industrial landscapes and layered, fabric-textured typography to create a modern country aesthetic.
